summary: The recorded base reproduced the exact draft-KV under-reservation: the resolver used tp_size=16 instead of allocator-matching attn_tp_size=1 and computed 2560 rather than 40960 bytes/token in the independent bfloat16 case. The exact candidate switches the resolver to attn_tp_size. Candidate regressions and independent topology, dtype, head-clamping, pool-capacity, and gfx950 allocation-byte checks passed.

tests.command: independent inline resolver probe on recorded base (tp=16, attn_tp=1)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before topology argument and draft bytes/token; observed get_num_kv_heads(16) and 2560 bytes versus expected get_num_kv_heads(1) and 40960 bytes.
Candidate regression on full DP attention, partial DP attention, and unchanged no-DP topology; 3 passed.

tests.command: independent inline adversarial resolver, budget, and GPU byte probe on candidate
tests.what_was_measured: Full/partial/no-DP widths, KV-head clamping, bfloat16 and fp8 byte sizes, combined pool token capacity, and actual gfx950 tensor storage; all assertions passed.
Existing DFLASH draft geometry, DCP replication, and HybridSWA budget behavior; 3 passed, 2 subtests passed, 38 deselected.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, ROCm 7.2. Actual fp8 GPU tensors measured 21504 bytes for attention-local draft geometry and 1344 bytes for the incorrect raw-TP geometry, ratio 16.

remaining_limitations: Kimi-K3 and DSPARK model weights were unavailable.
The reported 16-way B300 deployment and full serving-path OOM/startup were not reproduced; only one AMD MI355X/gfx950 GPU was assigned.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
